description:
From ISS-001, f0c6874. OMP JS eval and unknown tools are classed observed, run first, and ADW scans changed files afterwards (pi/extensions/agent-discipline-watcher/tool-adapter.ts:243-283, lifecycle-handlers.ts:333). Before f0c6874 they were unknown-write and blocked.

Fix: restore the pre-execution block for JS eval and unknown write-capable tools, keep the post-run scan for known read tools. Check git show f0c6874 for the deleted js-dispatch.ts and its test as reference. Update README:226 and CHANGELOG.

Acceptance: an OMP eval call blocks before execution; a read tool still runs. Tests (pi test runner) by adw-test-writer.
title: Block OMP JavaScript eval and unknown write tools before they run
